paper_title: Spectra of axions emitted from main sequence stars
coupling_convention: canonical g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis
notes: Paper computes stellar axion background (StAB) from main-sequence stars and derives a 95% CL exclusion on axion-photon coupling g_agamma vs axion mass m_a (~keV) from the NuSTAR cosmic X-ray background (Fig. 7). This is a genuine astrophysical/cosmological bound (not a DM haloscope), so no local DM density applies. Numerical data_points are approximate readings of the excluded swatch, which lies just below the globular-cluster/CAST cooling bound (6.6e-11 GeV^-1) over m_a ~ 1-30 keV; no data table is provided so values are estimated from the figure. The paper notes the same limits apply to a scalar with photon coupling g_sgamma. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 33)) | Vision: Figure 7. Lower boundary of the NuSTAR blue exclusion region (95% CL) traced. The region is bounded above at ~6e-11 by the globular cluster constraint. Boundary shows a flat plateau ~3.5e-11 for m_a ~1-3 keV, a bump peaking ~4.5e-11 near 10-11 keV, a deep dip to ~3e-11 near 19-21 keV, then rising steeply. Dashed diagonal lines are axion lifetime contours (tau_a), not benchmark coupling models.
